plot: The afternoon after the reunion Grandma and June leave the rusty tin they dug up under the apple tree on the kitchen counter; Crispy refuses to warm the lid because he only burns things, Bup's teaspoon tapping pops it open, but inside is a blank card and June will think Rosie tricked her again, until Lolly smells lemons and Bup remembers Grandma's joke about June's 'lemon spy letters' (said at the start) — the twist: it's invisible lemon ink, and scared-of-himself Crispy gently heats it so the words appear ('Our bakery is waiting') and a hidden key turns up; June laughs and cries, the key's tag says Maple Street Bakery, closed fifty years — yet tonight a light is on inside.

script.title: Why Is Rosie's Secret Card Blank?

beats.say: Fifty years under a tree, and this tin still won't open!
M-maybe it doesn't want to be opened.
Afternoon. Grandma and June dug it up at noon.
Now it sits on the counter. Rusty. Something rattles inside.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Grandma and June went next door to find a hammer.
Grandma laughed on the way out: June and her lemon spy letters!
They'll be back soon. Let's take one little peek.
Rust glues the lid shut. We need force. Or heat.
Crispy. Warm metal grows a tiny bit. Sit on the lid.
No. I burn things. That's all I ever do.
Whatever's in there is fifty years old. I'd ruin it.
Fine. Then we do it the old way. Tap, tap, tap.
Bup taps around the rim with a teaspoon. Tink. Tink.
Rust flakes fall like brown snow. The lid creaks.
Pop! The lid flies off and lands on Pim like a hat.
I'm f-fine. I live here now. Under the lid.
The bros climb up the rim and peer inside.
One folded white card. That's it. Nothing else.
Open it, Bup. Gently. It's Rosie's big secret!
Bup unfolds it. The front is blank. The back is blank.
Fifty years under a tree... for a blank card?
Maybe the ink faded. Sun, rain, fifty winters.
Or it's g-ghost writing. Only ghosts can read it.
There are no ghosts, Pim. Only very old paper.
If June sees this blank, she'll think Rosie tricked her again!
Footsteps outside. Grandma and June are coming back.
Lolly sniffs the card. Then she sniffs it again.
Wait. Why does a fifty-year-old card smell like lemons?
Lemons... Grandma said it! June and her lemon spy letters!
Of course! Lemon juice dries invisible. Heat turns it brown.
An old spy trick. The words were there all along!
Then the toaster! Quick! Toast the card!
Pim, NO. Toasters make charcoal. We want words.
Everyone turns slowly. And everyone looks at Crispy.
Not me. Everything I touch turns black. You know that.
Mr. Pot burnt you. That doesn't mean it's all you are.
Gentle heat. Like a warm hand. You've got this.
The front door handle turns. They have one chance.
Crispy holds the card high above his glowing eyes. Slowly.
A soft brown line appears. Then a letter. Then a word.
June. I never forgot you. Our bakery is waiting. Rosie.
And under the words, a tiny drawing of a key.
Bup lifts the tin's paper lining. Something gold clinks.
I didn't burn it. Not one corner. Look at it.
You didn't just warm a card, Crispy. You saved it.
The door swings open. The bros dive behind the bread box.
June reads the brown words. She laughs and cries at once.
Grandma lifts the key. On its tag: Maple Street Bakery.
Walter's old bakery. Closed for fifty years.
But tonight, across the street, a light is on inside.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Why Is Rosie's Secret Card Blank? 💌 (Ep 23)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"Everything I touch turns black. That's what I thought, anyway." — Crispy
Grandma's fifty-year-old tin finally opens on an autumn afternoon — and the only thing inside is a blank card. The Dough Bros have one minute before June walks back in.

es.title: ¿Por qué está en blanco la tarjeta de Rosie? 💌 (Ep 23)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Todo lo que toco se vuelve negro. Eso pensaba, por lo menos." — Crispy
La lata de la abuela, enterrada hace cincuenta años, por fin se abre una tarde de otoño… y dentro solo hay una tarjeta en blanco. Los Dough Bros tienen un minuto antes de que June vuelva.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Por que o cartão secreto da Rosie está em branco? 💌 (Ep 23)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Tudo o que eu toco fica preto. Pelo menos era o que eu achava." — Crispy
A lata de cinquenta anos da vovó finalmente abre numa tarde de outono — e a única coisa lá dentro é um cartão em branco. Os Dough Bros têm um minuto antes de a June voltar.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: لماذا بطاقة روزي السرية فارغة؟ 💌 (Ep 23)
ar.description:
ماذا تظن أنه سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"كل ما ألمسه يصبح أسود. هذا ما كنت أظنه على الأقل." — كريسبي
علبة الجدة المدفونة منذ خمسين عامًا تُفتح أخيرًا في عصر خريفي — ولا يوجد بداخلها سوى بطاقة فارغة. أمام الأصدقاء دقيقة واحدة قبل أن تعود جون.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Pourquoi la carte secrète de Rosie est vide ? 💌 (Ep 23)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Tout ce que je touche devient noir. C'est ce que je croyais, en tout cas." — Crispy
La vieille boîte en fer de Mamie s'ouvre enfin, un après-midi d'automne — et dedans, il n'y a qu'une carte blanche. Les Dough Bros ont une minute avant que June ne revienne.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: ロージーの秘密のカードはなぜ白紙？ 💌 (Ep 23)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「さわるものは全部黒くなる。少なくとも、そう思ってた。」— クリスピー
50年前の缶が秋の午後にやっと開いた。でも中にあったのは白紙のカード1枚だけ。ジューンが戻るまで、ドウ・ブロスに残された時間はあと1分。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 로지의 비밀 카드는 왜 비어 있을까? 💌 (Ep 23)
ko.description:
다음 편에서는 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"내가 만지는 건 다 까맣게 돼. 적어도 그렇게 생각했어." — 크리스피
할머니의 50년 된 깡통이 어느 가을 오후 마침내 열린다 — 그런데 안에 든 건 빈 카드 한 장뿐. 도우 브로스에게는 준이 돌아오기까지 1분밖에 없다.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Warum ist Rosies geheime Karte leer? 💌 (Ep 23)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Alles, was ich berühre, wird schwarz. Dachte ich jedenfalls." — Crispy
Omas fünfzig Jahre alte Blechdose geht an einem Herbstnachmittag endlich auf – und drinnen liegt nur eine leere Karte. Die Dough Bros haben eine Minute, bevor June zurückkommt.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
